Environment note: psycopg2-binary failed to build from source in this sandbox (missing libpq-fe.h); installed/tested without it since SQLite is this repo's default and Postgres is an opt-in docker-compose profile, not something this sandbox needs to exercise. Digest PDF generation hit two environment issues: fpdf2 pulls in a broken system cryptography package (same rust-binding panic prior runs hit) and a broken system PIL (compiled for a different Python ABI than what is actually running) -- worked around by stubbing cryptography and blocking the PIL import before importing fpdf, consistent with the prior run's workaround. Also hit a new issue this run: this fpdf2 version leaves the X cursor at the right margin after multi_cell() by default (unlike cell()), so a second multi_cell() call with width=0 had no horizontal space left and raised FPDFException -- fixed by passing new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT" explicitly on every multi_cell() call, matching what the cell() calls already do.
